scope: SLC43 tree rebuilt with a FULL-LENGTH zebrafish slc43a2a from Ensembl in place of UniProt's 153 aa fragment. A gene tree places sequences; it does not prove orthology.
why: The first SLC43 tree could not discriminate the a and b paralogs of slc43a2 because the only zebrafish slc43a2a reference available in UniProt is a 153 aa fragment, which carries almost no phylogenetic signal. Ensembl has the full-length protein (ENSDARG00000036848, canonical translation 571 aa; longest isoform used here). This is the data the open Problem zf2ff-problem-lat4a-identifier was blocked on.
question: Does either flying-fish LAT4-like locus group with the full-length zebrafish slc43a2a rather than with slc43a2b?
fragment_dropped: ZF_slc43a2a_FRAGMENT (UniProt Q7ZUS0, 153 aa) is removed from this input; it is retained in data/census_slc43/ for the record.
